precondition: Existing local plant records; this example uses hypothetical fixtures. A new product must separately define how users create or import records.
outcome: Find the correct individual plant, inspect its record, edit location or notes, and persist changes offline without changing another plant.

design_contract.selection_note: Illustrative selection within this example; not a user decision or a tested design

criteria.title: Search by plant ID opens the correct individual when names or variety labels overlap
Individual ID, display name and species or variety are distinct; unverified labels retain uncertainty
Offline save updates only the selected plant and persists after closing and reopening the app
Save failure preserves the draft; cancel, back and changing selection handle unsaved work explicitly
The flow remains usable on selected iPhone and iPad configurations with large text and selected accessibility tools
Origin preserves propagation method, known relationships and unknown information without inferring missing parents
Integrated assets retain truthful content and provenance, with correct fallback, appearance and semantics in the selected runtime; optional missing photos remain usable
List and detail read/edit layouts preserve baseline B-01 revision 1 across scoped states, including identity, components, terminology, selection, drafts and feedback
